The PKGBUILD fetches a versioned tarball from the official upstream (git.skyjake.fi) with a pinned SHA-256 checksum, uses standard cmake/make build steps, and contains no top-level code execution. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen3-235b model failed with HTTP 400 BadRequestError on all three files, producing no verdict signal. The deepseek-v4-flash model successfully audited all files and found them safe. The openrouter/free report (advisory-only) corroborated the safe verdict. The 'inconclusive' result was a tool error, not a security finding.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507: API request failed (HTTP 400) for all files - no verdict signal produced
learnings: API failures should be distinguished from genuine security inconclusiveness - a model that crashes produces no verdict signal and should not trigger disagreement escalation
When one model fails completely due to tool errors, the system should rely on successful models' verdicts rather than treating the failure as a disagreement requiring resolution
The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback models when API requests fail, to avoid wasting escalation resources on tool errors
